zod_strict_object.verdict: masteryThresholdsSchema in packages/knowledge-space-core/src/mastery-state.ts is declared with z.strictObject (line 47), rejecting extra keys at parse time.
zod_strict_object.detail: The schema parses the frozen default thresholds and the test suite asserts that adding an extraKey throws. knowledgeStateEntrySchema uses z.object (line 113) — acceptable for Phase 1 because the contract test only requires strict extra-key rejection on the threshold configuration object; the entry schema already validates ranges, enum values, and required fields.

frozen_default_thresholds.verdict: MASTERY_THRESHOLDS_DEFAULT is created with Object.freeze (line 36) and the test suite asserts Object.isFrozen(...) is true.
frozen_default_thresholds.detail: Freezing prevents runtime tampering with global mastery thresholds; per-call overrides are typed as Partial<MasteryThresholds> and must be supplied explicitly.

input_validation_signatures.verdict: Phase 1 owns function signatures only; getKnowledgeState and getOuterFringe are stubs with typed parameters but no runtime validation bodies.
input_validation_signatures.detail: getKnowledgeState accepts student: KnowledgeStateStudentRef, evidence: readonly KnowledgeStateEvidence[], graph: KnowledgeSpace, now: number, and optional thresholds?: Partial<MasteryThresholds>. getOuterFringe accepts state: Map<string, KnowledgeStateEntry>, graph: KnowledgeSpace, and optional readinessFn?: ReadinessFn. Runtime input validation is scheduled for Phase 2/3 when the implementations are filled in.
